chemical_intuition.title: Why grow a ferrite shell on CoO?
chemical_intuition.author_evidence: XRD detects two phases, with stronger ferrite features at longer annealing; TEM/HRTEM show a larger particle and different inner/outer fringes.
chemical_intuition.author_interpretation: Seed growth forms an inverted AFM-core/FiM-shell structure and allows the CoO core to remain highly crystalline.
chemical_intuition.curator_caveat: XRD alone does not prove geometry, as the paper explicitly acknowledges. No independent nucleation fraction is quantified.
chemical_intuition.outlook: Spatially resolved composition could test interface width and any separately nucleated ferrite. This is an unperformed follow-up, not a source result.

chemical_intuition.title: Lattice shifts and the proposed interface strain
chemical_intuition.author_evidence: CoO lattice a changes from 4.258 to 4.246 Å; shell phase a=8.373 Å.
chemical_intuition.author_interpretation: Authors attribute the CoO shift to lattice mismatch and strain at the core–shell interface.
chemical_intuition.curator_caveat: The paper does not provide an atomically refined strain map or interface composition profile.
chemical_intuition.outlook: Separate strain and chemical intermixing measurements would test this explanation.

chemical_intuition.title: Exchange bias as an indirect probe of the interface
chemical_intuition.author_evidence: The selected cohort shows HE=5.6 kOe at 2 K and high coercivity, with field-cooling dependence.
chemical_intuition.author_interpretation: Crystalline CoO, a thin ferrite shell and a sharp interface stabilize exchange coupling; authors explicitly use EB as an indirect interface-quality indicator.
chemical_intuition.curator_caveat: Interface sharpness is an interpretation supported indirectly; no measured atom-by-atom interface or controlled roughness series is supplied. Initial cooling temperature conflicts across sections.
chemical_intuition.outlook: A controlled interface-composition series and independent chemical mapping could distinguish proposed mechanisms.

chemical_intuition.title: Broad size distributions and magnetic heterogeneity
chemical_intuition.author_evidence: Means 12 and 14.9 nm have reported ± spreads of 3.2 and 3.6 nm; blocking peak 292 K and a 200–250 K shoulder.
chemical_intuition.author_interpretation: Authors associate broad heterostructure size with the core distribution and suggest a trace uncoated-CoO contribution to the shoulder.
chemical_intuition.curator_caveat: The ± statistic and uncoated-phase fraction are not measured/defined. 291 K is a literature bulk Néel reference, not a new sample measurement.
chemical_intuition.outlook: Particle-resolved morphology and composition, together with magnetic distribution analysis, could test the uncoated-core assignment.

chemical_intuition.title: What is known about the reaction medium?
chemical_intuition.author_evidence: Commercial OA/OlAm and Co(II)/Fe(II) acetates are used in separately degassed mixtures and staged thermal treatment.
chemical_intuition.author_interpretation: The authors describe thermal decomposition and controlled seed growth; they do not report a molecular precursor-conversion mechanism.
chemical_intuition.curator_caveat: Do not invent metal–ligand connectivity, hydrate composition, oxygen source, surface ligand coverage or an experimentally demonstrated ligand-specific causal role.
chemical_intuition.outlook: Speciation and reaction-kinetics measurements would be needed to make those mechanistic assignments.

chemical_intuition.title: Heating performance is limited by dispersion knowledge
chemical_intuition.author_evidence: Approximately 355 W/g is calculated from a 0.034 °C/s initial slope at 500 kHz and 37.4 kA/m; particles settle in water.
chemical_intuition.author_interpretation: Authors propose that improved water dispersibility could increase apparent SLP by preventing sedimentation.
chemical_intuition.curator_caveat: This is a proposed improvement. No ligand-exchange protocol, stable aqueous formulation, active-mass measurement or biological outcome is demonstrated.
chemical_intuition.outlook: A controlled water-transfer study and mass-resolved heating assay could test the proposal.
